sloka: उत्सृष्टस्तु तदा गर्भो घनशब्दसमस्वनः ।तयोत्सृष्टः स तु शिशुः शरदर्कसमद्युतिः ।निधायास्ये स्वयं मुष्टिं रुरोद शनकैस्तदा ।। ७.४.२६ ॥
transliteration: utsṛṣṭastu tadā garbho ghanaśabdasamasvanaḥ ।tayotsṛṣṭaḥ sa tu śiśuḥ śaradarkasamadyutiḥ ।nidhāyāsye svayaṁ muṣṭiṁ ruroda śanakaistadā ।। 7.4.26 ॥

translations.english: The abandoned offspring, who had a roar like thunder and a luster like the autumn sun, then cried slowly, having placed his own fist in his mouth.
